# benchmark-payment-delegation

> Spend limits, merchant allowlists and disputes for an agent with a card.

Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/benchmark-payment-delegation
Repository: https://github.com/pooriaarab/benchmark-payment-delegation
Directory: https://aibenchmarkindex.com/benchmarks/benchmark-payment-delegation

## Exports

The root exports `benchmark`, `run`, and `score`. `benchmark-payment-delegation/api` exports the fetch-style `handler`. `benchmark-payment-delegation/mcp` exports MCP builders.

## Commands

The CLI supports list, show, run, score, card, provenance, index-entry, serve, and mcp. Use the mock provider for offline verification.

## Verification

Run `npm run ci:local`. The report is `artifacts/e2e-report.json`.
